error_reason: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the comparison of birth years, concluding that 1960 is greater than 1938 implies the person born in 1960 is 'older', failing the fundamental definition that a smaller birth year corresponds to an older age, which directly caused the selection of the wrong film.

hypotheses.rationale: The planner asserts that Andrei Svislotskiy was born in 1960 and Fred Williamson in 1938, then concludes that the film directed by Andrei Svislotskiy is the answer because '1960 > 1938'. This is the decisive error because it incorrectly applies the definition of 'older' (which implies a smaller birth year) to the numbers, or simply fails to realize that 1938 represents an older person than 1960. Had this verification/logic step been performed correctly, the Planner would have identified 1938 as the earlier (older) date and selected Fred Williamson, preventing the wrong final answer.
